title: Photo Booth
description: A chemical photo booth's delivery slot. Press the chrome button for a countdown and four flashes, and a wet strip of portraits printed in Geist Mono characters feeds out of the slot; pull it sideways to tear it off at the perforation.
intent: One physical object finished to the edge: a booth strip of four shape-matched ASCII prints on glossy paper that dries matte, hanging from a slot as stiff paper you can swing, tear along a real perforation, and toss onto a pile.
